signature: On bell garland: "MACHT o IOHANN o CARL o KODISCH o NVRNB 1701"; master's mark: jumping horse, "I C K."
pitch: With slide closed: B$-40 cents @ a=440; with slide drawn ca. 44mm, B%+30 cents.
dimensions: bo 10.3/10.1, be 123, le 2619.5, slide sec. 1635, bell sec. 1005, overlap 30.5, int. diam. of mouthpipe 11.7, int. diam. of slide receiver 9.8, ext. diam. of neckpipe above first ferrule 11.7, ext. diam. of neckpipe at bow 12.3/12.6, ext. diam. of bellpipe at bow 11.6/12.5 (repaired)
remarks: Tubular slide-stays; flat bell-stay; highly decorated bell garland, bell-stay; eyelet in slide brace; saddles but no rings in slide-bow, bell-bow; patches on bell bow; Terminal bell flare more extreme than most specimens of this period; restored at some point prior to acquisition at US-VE
